Pamela J. Hunter, (D) 128th A.D.". This is her current look; the clip's poster still (vidclips/20261109.jpg) has her looking down, so the frame was pulled from the video where she faces the camera. Face ~260px across. Earlier sources: the June 10, 2025 press-conference still (video/26689, vidclips/20250610.jpg) shows long dark curls with caramel highlights and no glasses; the May 28, 2026 stills show braids; the Assembly directory headshot (member_files/128/headshot/128.jpg) is only 134x200 and dates from about 2015. No Commons photo exists.
